items.name: BeCubed Summer 2018

venue.name: Anderson-Abruzzo Albuquerque International Balloon Museum
venue.address: 9201 Balloon Museum Dr. NE Albuquerque, New Mexico 87113

items.information:
The registration fee for competitors is $30. Spectators will also have to pay in order to get in to the museum.

Adults	$4.00
  ($1 discount with valid NM ID) 
Seniors 65+	                    $2.00
Children 4-12	                  $2.00
Children 3 and under 	      Free

Due to the size of the venue, there is a 100 competitor limit at this event and you must register online.

NO refunds and NO day of registration.

items.name: Mariupol Open 2018
items.information:
Участие в соревнованиях бесплатное. Регистрация закроется 20 июля или когда мы одобрим 100 участников. При достижении лимита зарегистрироваться на месте будет нельзя. Ознакомьтсь также с информацией во вкладках.

Registration will be closed on July 20 or when we reach 100 competitors. No at the door regsitration will be accepted if we reach competitor limit. Participation is free, spectators are welcome. Check out the tabs for more information!
